mechanism: Chlorthalidone may cause hypokalemia and hyponatremia, which can potentiate anticoagulant effects and increase bleeding risk; additionally, diuretic-induced volume depletion may increase enoxaparin concentration.
action: Monitor electrolytes (particularly potassium) regularly; assess bleeding risk and clinical signs; ensure adequate hydration; adjust enoxaparin dosing if renal function declines due to diuretic use.
